---
name: Something is confusing
about: Report a broken step, confusing wording, or an unhelpful error
title: "[Confusing]: "
labels: ["documentation", "confusion"]
---

### What page or skill were you using?

Give us the file path or link (for example, `skills/how-to-add-a-skill.md`).

### What did you expect to happen?

Explain what you thought was going to happen in plain words.

### What actually happened?

Tell us where you got stuck, what went wrong, or what words felt confusing.

### Do you have a suggestion to make it clearer?

Optional. If you have an idea for simpler wording, share it here.
